corrections.reason: The standard Andemta technical term for literal meaning is 'በቁሙ' (2nd order ቁ, clearly visible in the image), misread as 'በቀሙ'.
The printed Ge'ez text in the image reads 'ወሎሙሰ ኢተውህበ ።' (matching the citation 'ወሎሙሰ ኢተውህበ ላለው' in Col 1 L35 and Col 2 L03-04), without '-ቦሙ'.
Amharic verb 'ይቀሙታልና' ('they rob/deprive him of it', matching Col 1 L33 'ይቀሙታልና') is printed with 1st-order 'ቀ', misread as 7th-order 'ቆ'.
The canonical cross-reference for Isaiah's prophecy of spiritual blindness is Romans 11:8 ('ሮሜ ፲፩ ፰'), and both numerals '፲፩' are printed in the image.
Classical Ge'ez verb 'ትሰምዑ' (from ሰምዐ with pharyngeal ዐ) is printed with 'ዑ', misread as 'ኡ'.
Ge'ez broken plural 'ወአዕዛኒክሙ' ('and your ears', Matthew 13:16) begins with 1st-order 'አ', misread as 6th-order 'እ'.
Ge'ez 2nd person plural pronoun 'አንትሙ' (Matthew 13:17) begins with 1st-order 'አ', misread as 'እ'.
The printed glyph in the image is 'ሠርተዋልና' with 'ሠ' (ንጉሡ ሠ), misread as 'ሰ'.
